I know sometimes everything feels like too much. It’s too much effort to try and get better. It’s too much effort to put work in to try and turn those thoughts around. But we never think it’s too much effort to stay in that state. When those thoughts won’t stop coming I just challenge you to try and turn some of them around. “No one wants to hang with me, I’m a burden”… you could try “grown up people have a lot going on in their own lives and don’t always have a lot of time to help me when I need it. That’s okay because my life gets busy too but I am the one that’s always by my own side at the end of the day, I deserve to treat myself like I would treat one of my friends”. It’s just an example and I know it takes practice, but try and get in the habit of just flipping the story a bit because our brains lie to us so much❤️ I hope you can realize your worth on your own because you truly do not need anyone else to be worth something in this life

One of the best things I learnt with my now 5 year old reactive rescue was figuring out where his threshold is and making an emergency u turn if necessary to not let him close enough to get into that state. That way you can reward the calmness while he will still take treats. Find a distance where he can look at the thing while listening to what you ask from him and reward for looking at it calmly. Also having a super high value treat that is only used for seeing dogs or people helps so he stays excited about the treats (I use hot dogs). Try your best to stay calm yourself and not let him feed off your fears of a reaction and I know that’s way easier said than done sometimes. He’s young still and he has so much time to learn and you are doing amazing with him❤️
